description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You are critically hit by an enemy's Strike or critically fail at a basic saving throw against an enemy's spell or effect.

You deny the extent of your injuries so convincingly that you fool not just your assailant but your own body. You attempt a Performance check to Lie against the triggering enemy's Perception DC.

Critical Success The enemy's Strike is a success instead of a critical success, or your saving throw is a failure instead of a critical failure.

Success You take damage as if the Strike were a success instead of a critical success or the saving throw were a failure instead of a critical failure, but other effects apply as they normally would.

Failure The triggering effect applies to you as it normally would.

Critical Failure As a failure, but your protestations that you weren't harmed come across as particularly pathetic. You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard] to the triggering enemy until the end of their next turn.
